description_for_human: Find and book desks and meeting rooms with an interactive office map.

functions.name: get_office_map
functions.description: Shows an interactive seat map of an office floor for a given date, with desk and meeting room availability.

date.description: Date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Defaults to today.

functions.name: book_desk
functions.description: Books a desk for the current user on a given date.

deskId.description: The desk identifier, for example desk-1-04.

date.description: Date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Defaults to today.

functions.name: get_my_bookings
functions.description: Lists the current user's upcoming desk and meeting room bookings.

functions.name: cancel_booking
functions.description: Cancels one of the current user's bookings by id.

bookingId.description: The booking id to cancel, for example bk-0007.

functions.name: who_is_in_office
functions.description: Lists colleagues with a desk booked on a given date.

date.description: Date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Defaults to today.
